reviews.title: I use it a lot but…it’s broken.
reviews.text:
I’ve tried to get help on this issue by directly reaching out but haven’t heard anything back in months so, this is my last resort. 

I think overall that the app is better than one star and I’ll gladly update my review once they fix some of the issues. 

The biggest one is that when you make a note into a checklist, you can no longer open the note or edit it beyond checking things off. I have a note that I have now effectively lost because I can’t see the note beyond the preview. 

Another issue is that you sometimes lose info if you leave the app to do something like check text if you didn’t save the note because the app may refresh when you return. 

Lastly, a few small things that I wish would be updated. 1) No longer being forced to name notes. 2) being able to hide the keyboard so you can view a note in full screen. 3) bullet points!

reviews.title: Counterintuitive
reviews.text:
It is difficult to change existing notes.  It’s great to have a list displayed on the home screen but that list needs to be easily edit able. Also how do I make it display the beginning of the list rather than the end?  Reordering tasks is difficult.  
Overall hard to use and not enough instructions. 
I want to see the first/top items displayed on the Home Screen. Tap a button to open the note/ list and then tap another a button to open the note in an editing screen. I want to be able to add, change, and remove tasks and then rearrange them in order the way I want. 
If this app can do all of these things, then please make the instructions easy to find.  I’m signed up to pay for the app but can’t use it.
